cs.t: Until they make better smartphones, I highly recommend using a PopSocket.  I have the magnetic PopSocket which connects to my phone using the MagSafe-compatible ring built-in to the thin TPU case for my Pixel phone.  With it, my phone just sits on my fingers with the PopSocket secured between two of my fingers.  No hand pain.
cs.th: How to Deal with Horrible Smartphone Ergonomics

cs.t: I use a popsocket on a naked iphone 14 pro and it's great in my experience. I don't think I've dropped it once after going worth this setup.
